name: 86 Chaos 16.0.42 Auto-Fill Visibility Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.42 Auto-Fill Visibility Fix
notes: Fixes Schedule Builder Auto-Fill so committed shifts use current roster identity, appear immediately after save, and do not report a false visible success when drafts land outside the active schedule window.
releaseNotes: Auto-Fill now resolves copied shifts to the active roster before creating the target draft shifts.
Drafted Auto-Fill shifts include canonical schedule identity, schedule date keys, month keys, and draft/publish metadata used by the Schedule Builder grid.
After a successful batch commit, newly drafted shifts are kept visible in the current Schedule Builder session while the Firestore listener catches up.
The Auto-Fill toast now distinguishes visible drafts from shifts saved outside the current schedule window.
